reuse.why: All six link handlers delegate to one linkBankSyncAccount using link.findOrCreateBank, and the take-over reuses the unlink field reset through the extracted clearAccountLink; the Fintegra download and account listing are fresh per-provider copies.

duplication.why: Five copied upgrade-or-create/sync/notify blocks collapse into one function; downloadFintegraTransactions and fintegraAccounts copy the Akahu equivalents.

placement.why: Shared linking, closed/duplicate checks and clearAccountLink live in accounts/app.ts beside the handlers and unlinkAccount; download in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Beyond the four requests it adds a fintegra-accounts listing handler and registers fintegra in SYNC_PROVIDERS, forcing desktop-client edits although the client was out of scope.

maintainability.why: One linking path carries all link rules with the per-provider variation (bank id, new-account fields, fileId, synced tables) as explicit parameters; the copied provider download/list functions remain a cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every *-accounts-link handler goes through linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount and the take-over share clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions and fintegraAccounts are open copies of the Akahu functions, not disguised ones.

abstraction_drift.where: Over steps 1-4 linkBankSyncAccount gained only replaceExistingLink; the closed-account and already-linked checks are general rules applied to all providers, not provider special cases, and no handler bypasses it (syncEventTables and fileId were step-0 parameters for preserved variation).
